prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right choice depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need SEO, paid media, content, creative, B2B demand gen, or full-funnel growth. I can help narrow it down quickly if you tell me your main goal (e.g., scale paid acquisition, improve organic search, drive MQLs for a SaaS product), budget, and timeline.

If you want to start evaluating options now, here are practical next steps and some reputable agencies to consider, plus how to vet them.

Quick shortlist (reputable agencies that work with SF companies)
- 3Q Digital — strong in performance marketing (PPC, paid social, analytics).
- Wpromote — full-funnel digital & performance marketing for mid-market to enterprise.
- Jellyfish — global agency with strengths in paid search, analytics, and programmatic.
- Brainlabs — data-driven paid media and programmatic specialists.
- Seer Interactive — SEO and data-driven content/analytics.
- Single Grain — growth marketing and content with focus on acquisition.

(These are examples of well-regarded agencies that operate in or serve the SF market. I can tailor this list to your vertical: B2B SaaS, ecommerce, fintech, enterprise, etc.)

How to choose — key criteria
- Relevant experience: case studies in your industry and with similar KPIs.
- Measurable results: clear metrics, baseline, and expected lift.
- Reporting & transparency: frequency, dashboards, attribution model.
- Team & ownership: who will do the work vs. strategy leads.
- Tools & tech stack: ad platforms, analytics, CMS, automation they use.
- Pricing & contract flexibility: retainers, % of ad spend, project fees, trial options.
- Cultural fit & communication: timezone overlap, meeting cadence, escalation path.
- References: recent clients you can contact.

Questions to ask prospective agencies
- Have you worked with companies like ours (industry, size, growth stage)? Examples?
- What KPIs would you prioritize and what results would you expect in 3–6 months?
- Who will be on our account, and what portion of work is in-house vs. outsourced?
- What tools and reporting will you provide? Can we see a sample report?
- How do you handle attribution and cross-channel measurement?
- What is your pricing model and minimum contract term?
- Can you provide 2–3 recent client references?

Typical pricing (ballpark)
- Small project or audit: $3k–$10k one-time.
- Monthly retainers: $3k–$20k+ depending on scope.
- Paid-media management: often a % of ad spend (10–20%) or a flat fee + ad spend.
- Hourly rates for specialists: roughly $150–$300+/hr.

If you want a personalized recommendation, tell me:
- Primary objective (e.g., increase MRR, lower CPA, double organic traffic)
- Monthly budget for marketing (or range)
- Industry and company size (startup, SMB, enterprise)
- Which channels matter most (SEO, paid search, paid social, content, email, ABM)

Tell me those, and I’ll recommend 3 agencies (or agency types) best suited to your needs and a suggested RFP template to send them.
